_comment: Bluesecor — Senior Backend Developer (Remote) and SW Engineer Python & Cloud (Belgium). One CV, both listings.
summary: Backend engineer with 9 years of shipping production software, most of it Python. I build FastAPI services and REST APIs on PostgreSQL and Redis with Kafka and MQTT feeding them, and I've owned the real-time ingest and playback side of a live telemetry product. I also architect and run the Kubernetes platform behind Slovakia's national e-government, so deployment, monitoring and security remediation are part of my job rather than someone else's.
emphasize: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, ALB, S3)

skills.label: Cloud & Delivery
items: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, ALB, S3)

experience.name: NASES — National e-Government Platform
bullets: Architect the platform behind slovensko.sk and work daily with the backend teams building on it: API and service design, PostgreSQL and Oracle data layers, Kafka (Strimzi) messaging and end-to-end monitoring.

Own authentication and secrets across the estate — OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect through Keycloak, HashiCorp Vault, TLS and certificate automation — plus the vulnerability scanning and remediation loop enforced in the shared GitLab CI pipelines.
Build and run the internal developer platform teams deploy onto: Kubernetes/OpenShift, Terraform, GitLab CI and Argo CD.

experience.name: LiveAgent
bullets: Six years building a help-desk SaaS used by tens of thousands of companies: backend feature work in PHP, Java and Python on MariaDB, Redis and ElasticSearch, plus the JavaScript frontend.
Drove the software-architecture decisions on the product using domain-driven design to model the ticketing and automation domains, and kept them coherent through years of refactoring.
Ran the AWS infrastructure behind it with Terraform — caching, search, queues and background workers; two years on the leadership team, mentoring engineers and running hiring.

experience.name: Lapz
bullets: Co-founded a spatial Formula 1 companion app for Apple Vision Pro and owned all real-time telemetry: ingesting external live data feeds and building the processing, buffering and playback pipeline that drove the visualisation, in Python and Swift.

experience.name: ViaJet
bullets: Co-founded and built a B2B2C private-jet charter marketplace end to end: Python and FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL schema design with geospatial queries over airports and routes, faceted search and the booking flow, with a TypeScript frontend.

experience.name: DXC Technology
bullets: Delivered an internal race-organisation web application on a two-person team: a Python (Flask) API on MySQL behind an Angular frontend, containerised with Docker and deployed to Azure.
